narrative: OMX30 faces a challenging open with negative global correlation (-0.818%) and bearish technical confirmation via MACD crossover below signal line. While the index trades +3.1% above its 200-MA (supporting underlying bull regime), the weak ADX (13.8) and -1.1% gap versus the 50-MA suggest momentum is stalling. Yields falling 52bps on 10Y treasury yields would normally support equities, but VIX spiking 433bps and NASDAQ down -1.88% overnight signal risk-off sentiment. Geopolitical escalation (Ukraine strikes, Russian asset unfreezing talks) adds uncertainty. Expect sector rotation toward defensive plays rather than broad bullish positioning.
morningBrief: OMX30 opens under pressure from negative global overnight signals (Nikkei -4.90%, Shanghai -1.59%, S&P -1.11%, NASDAQ -1.88%) offset only partially by FTSE +0.48%. Key technical red flags: MACD bearish crossover (hist=-0.641), weak ADX at 13.8 limiting trend confidence, and price trapped in lower half of Bollinger Bands (%B=0.27). Support sits at 3085 (lower band); resistance at 3180 (50-MA). Watch 3123 (yesterday close) for pivot confirmation. Defensives (Essity, AstraZeneca) should outperform on risk-off rotation. USD/SEK +0.23% and EUR/SEK +0.28% offer modest support to exporters (Volvo, Atlas Copco, Ericsson) but NASDAQ weakness will cap tech sentiment. US Jobless Claims (14:30 CET) and Ukraine headlines remain key intraday catalysts. Recommend hedging or reducing cyclical exposure; wait for ADX >18 before aggressive longs.
